errors.text_span: някои от тях са групирани по сходни тематични или функционални характеристики, като например „ISBN“, „eISBN“, „ISSN“, „eISSN“ и „страници“
errors.evidence: The description claims that certain categories are grouped by thematic characteristics. This is an interpretation, as the chart only shows visual adjacency, not explicit grouping. Furthermore, the claim is factually incorrect as it includes "страници" (pages) in the supposed group, but this category is visually separated from the others by several other bars.

errors.text_span: докато по-кратки стълбове се виждат при „eISBN“, „ISBN“ и „eISSN“
errors.evidence: The description uses "eISSN" (value 4) as an example of a "shorter bar". This is an over-generalization because there are several other bars that are shorter than or equal to the bar for "eISSN". Including it alongside the shortest bars (value 1) is misleading and a poor choice of example.
